claim_ceiling: V4 reaches real, individual, SHA-pinned event-level measurements and actual spacecraft metadata, and proves a synthetic multiburst source-lag identifiability pitfall. It neither produces a valid observed LAT/GBM likelihood ratio nor detects LIV, bounds lattice spacing, proves a simulated universe, confirms an AMPS firewall, or discovers a black-hole boom.
critical_negative_controls: Three independent NASA query IDs and exact byte SHA256 fingerprints
Malformed/truncated FITS, forged source files, unsupported BINTABLE columns and changed query filters fail closed
Mismatched spacecraft/event MET intervals and missing GTI/instrument quality reject events
FSSC Extended Pass8 event masks are decoded as FITS 32X, not incorrectly as array indices
Aperture photons never promoted to guaranteed GRB source membership
No matched 1 GeV emission counterpart inferred from the GBM trigger
Unconstrained independent burst energy lags force exactly nonidentifiable eta; no fit or astrophysical p-value
Source-intrinsic-only synthetic lags imitate the expected lattice signal under a false known-zero-source assumption
Toy conditional Monte Carlo p-value never interpreted as observed significance
No event PSF, EDISP, effective-area, diffuse background or clock calibration invented
V1/V2/V3 frozen SHA256 history preserved, BHB/AMPS/OSIRIS result authority unchanged

instrument_forward_model.interpretation: SOURCE-class and diagnostic angular cuts do not imply an IRF-folded probability model

joint_synthetic_source_and_propagation_l.conditional_alternative: eta>=0 assumed propagation under bounded source model
joint_synthetic_source_and_propagation_l.exact_degeneracy: eta->eta+delta, beta_j->beta_j-delta for all j leaves timing likelihood identical
joint_synthetic_source_and_propagation_l.negative_control: eta_true=0 but beta_j=0.8 mimics naive eta~0.8
joint_synthetic_source_and_propagation_l.nuisance_parameters: mu_j independent per source; beta_j intrinsic energy-dependent lag

synthetic_conditional_recovery.interpretation: Only identifiable if source delays are independently known to vanish

synthetic_intrinsic_prior_sensitivity.interpretation: Bayesian/ridge assumption drives an optional conditional result; prior is not empirically calibrated

unbounded_intrinsic_lag.interpretation: Exact eta + beta_j degeneracy; no observed speed bound

original_manifest.archive: NASA Fermi Science Support Center LATDataQuery.cgi / Extended Pass8 event and spacecraft products
original_manifest.processing_note: FSSC query outputs are public generated subsets (EV00/SC00), not the original complete weekly archive; each downloaded byte stream is SHA256 pinned. Raw binaries are not committed; --raw-dir requires exact archived files. Query outputs may be ephemeral.
original_manifest.redshift_note: Published approximate source redshifts used only to specify model projections; not independently remeasured here.
original_manifest.selection_note: Fixed simple quality cuts for diagnostic extraction only. Not optimized for individual sources, not an aperture correction, not a background fit and not an IRF forward fold.
original_manifest.time_note: MET at GBM trigger is provisionally reconstructed by adding the rounded fractional UTC seconds after the archive Gregorian query-window start to the FITS TSTART; not an authenticated GBM-to-LAT clock calibration. Time of emission remains unknown.
